raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fix loading sharded checkpoints from Hugging Face repository IDs. `load_weights()` previously treated the repository ID as a local path, causing shard lookup to fail.

## Claims

- Support HF repository IDs supplied through either `model` or `model_weights`.
- Honor the configured revision, download directory, and ignore patterns.
- Preserve existing handling for local directories and S3 paths.

## Validation

Added one parameterized regression test covering local checkpoints, HF repository IDs, and `model_weights` overrides. It uses real safetensors weights and mocks HF downloads and distributed parallel-state accessors.

- New regression cases before the fix: **2 failed, 1 passed**.
- Selected CPU tests after the fix, including all three regression cases: **28 passed, 6 deselected**.
- All applicable pre-commit hooks passed.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  --confcutdir=tests/model_executor/model_loader \
  tests/model_executor/model_loader/test_sharded_state_loader.py \
  -k 'filter_subtensors or default_pattern or save_model or resolves_checkpoint_path' -q

pre-commit run --files \
  vllm/model_executor/model_loader/sharded_state_loader.py \
  tests/model_executor/model_loader/test_sharded_state_loader.py
```

Full GPU integration, live HF downloads, and the RunAI backend were not tested locally.

## Details

Resolve the selected weight source using the existing `_prepare_weights()` method before searching for shard files. This converts HF repository IDs into local snapshot paths while retaining the existing handling for local directories and S3 paths.

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Reuses the existing weight resolver without introducing new helpers or dependencies.
- [ ] **Testing and Validation:** CPU regression tests pass; full end-to-end validation remains outstanding.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** All applicable pre-commit checks passed.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes the root cause, fix, regression tests, and validation limitations.

</details>

     )
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "model,model_weights,repo_id",
+    [("org/model", None, "org/model"), ("local/dir", "org/weights", "org/weights")],
+)
+def test_load_weights_resolves_hf_repo_id(
+    monkeypatch, tmp_path, model, model_weights, repo_id
+):
+    """HF repo IDs are downloaded with the requested revision before loading."""
+    _mock_pp_group(monkeypatch, 1)
+    weights = torch.arange(4, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(2, 2)
+    save_file({"weight": weights}, tmp_path / "model-rank-0-part-0.safetensors")
+    download = Mock(return_value=str(tmp_path))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        "vllm.model_executor.model_loader.sharded_state_loader.download_weights_from_hf",
+        download,
+    )
+    load_config = LoadConfig(
+        load_format="sharded_state",
+        download_dir=str(tmp_path / "cache"),
+        ignore_patterns=["unused/*"],
+    )
+    model_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        model=model, model_weights=model_weights, revision="checkpoint-revision"
+    )
+    linear = torch.nn.Linear(2, 2, bias=False)
+
+    ShardedStateLoader(load_config).load_weights(linear, model_config)
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(linear.weight, weights)
+    download.assert_called_once_with(
+        repo_id,
+        load_config.download_dir,
+        ["*.safetensors"],
+        "checkpoint-revision",
+        ignore_patterns=load_config.ignore_patterns,
+    )
+
